name: Audit Google Maps listings against approved branch details with HasData

parameters.content:
## 1. Add your approved branch details
Create Branches headers: `branch_id`, `place_id`, `expected_name`, `expected_address`, `expected_phone`, `expected_website`, `name_aliases`, `address_aliases`, `phone_aliases`, `website_aliases`. Name and address are required. Other comparison fields and aliases are optional. Set spreadsheet_id and country_calling_code in Settings.

## 2. Check the batch and saved results
Reject duplicate branch IDs, reused place IDs and oversized batches before paid requests. Read Results once and reject duplicate saved keys. Every branch is checked again. Saved comparisons provide the baseline for the next run, not a cache.

## 3. Compare the listing and save review tasks
Create Results headers: `result_key`, `checked_at`, `topic`, `status`, `summary`, `differences`, `unknown_fields`, `resolved_fields`, `place_id`, `evidence_json`. Review differences_to_review. Missing data stays unknown. resolved_fields marks previously different values that now match unchanged expectations. Optional review_status and editor_notes remain untouched.

# Check your branch listings before customers find a mismatch

### How it works
Compare each branch's approved name, address, phone and website with its Google Maps listing. The workflow fetches the exact place ID and writes differences, missing fields and the returned values to Google Sheets. Approved aliases accommodate alternate spellings. Phone comparisons normalize formatting, and website checks compare hostnames.

On later runs, the workflow retains the preceding comparison and identifies previously different fields that now match unchanged approved values. Failed requests, missing data and unexpected place IDs cannot resolve a difference. Your team gets a review queue, not automatic Google Business Profile edits. Opening hours remain available for manual review.

### Setup
Install the verified HasData community node. Connect HasData credentials to Fetch search evidence and Google Sheets credentials to Read input, Read Results and Save review queue. Create Branches and Results tabs with the headers in the white notes.

Enter spreadsheet_id and country_calling_code in Settings. Add one branch per row with its exact place ID, approved name and address. Keep IDs and phone numbers as plain text in Sheets. Optional aliases use one value per line in a cell. Start with one branch whose approved details you can verify.

### Customization
Use one country calling code per workflow. Adjust max_items up to ten branches. Each run makes one paid Maps Place request per branch, with no automatic retries or model calls. Run one execution at a time. Results stores the latest comparison and preceding field values. Export it before refreshing if you need a permanent history. Confirm differences before editing a listing.
